lecture_17.title: CS336 Spring 2026, Lecture 17: Multimodal models
lecture_17.note: Line anchors refer to the local shallow clone (sha256 d8c3054e..., recorded in discovered.json). The file's own heading is 'Lecture 17: multimodal models' (L5); the thread is registered as 'Alignment and multimodality' per the course listing, but the file contains no alignment section: the only post-training content is one line on Qwen3-VL ('SFT on long CoT data, knowledge distillation, RL', L257) and the Vicuna description (L128), which are linked to lecture_15/lecture_16 through external_prerequisites. Unlike lectures 2, 6 and 10 this file has no @inspect values at all: it is 177 text() claims, 32 image() figures and 20 link() citations, so every status is 'said', 'shown' or 'cited'. The only arithmetic this thread performs is on numbers the professor states as text (336/14 = 24 so 576 patches; 224/14 = 16 so 256 patches, 64 after 2x2 merging; 512x512 into 1024 tokens is a 32x32 grid, 16x16 pixels per token; log2(8192) = 13 bits per code) and it is always labelled as this thread's arithmetic. Numbers that live only inside embedded figures (clip-efficiency.png, siglip-parallelism.png, llava-onevision-data-*.png, llava-onevision-training.png, qwen-vl-stage*.png, qwen3-vl-pretraining.png, qwen3-vl-results.png, qwen2-vl-capabilities.png) are recorded as 'shown' and never restated. Dataset sizes, TPU-days and batch sizes stated in text (400M pairs, 32768, 16K/32K/1M, 10 days on 256 TPUv3, 5 days on 32 TPUv4, 158K examples, 2.9T/1.5T/400B tokens) are the professor's readings of the cited papers and are quoted with that attribution.

lecture_15.title: CS336 Spring 2026, Lecture 15: Mid/post-training, SFT and RLHF
lecture_15.note: Referenced only through external_prerequisites (lecture_15:<kp-id>). Vicuna is 'LLaMA fine-tuned on ShareGPT conversations' (L128), LLaVA's 158K GPT-4-generated conversations (L132-L134) are SFT data, and Qwen3-VL's post-training is 'SFT on long CoT data, knowledge distillation, RL' (L257); the SFT-then-RL recipe and the fact-you-do-not-know hallucination result were taught there. DPO and reward overoptimization do not appear in this file and carry no edge.

clip_2021.note: Linked at lecture_17.py:L49. Source of the contrastive objective (L57-L60, clip.png and clip-code.png), the 400M-pair WIT dataset and 500K-query collection (L64-L66), the ViT-L/14@336px best model (L78), the 63M-parameter text encoder (L81), the zero-shot ImageNet headline (L85) and the predict-text-versus-contrastive efficiency ablation (L88-L90, clip-efficiency.png, not restated).
